process FOLDDISCO_QUERY {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/folddisco:2.9375a2d--hb42e459_0':
        'quay.io/biocontainers/folddisco:2.9375a2d--hb42e459_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(pdb), val(query)
    tuple val(meta2), path(index), path(structures, stageAs: "structures/*")

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.tsv"), emit: results
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('folddisco'), eval("folddisco version"), topic: versions, emit: versions_folddisco

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    folddisco \\
        query \\
        --pdb ${pdb} \\
        --query ${query} \\
        --index ${index}/${index} \\
        --output ${prefix}.tsv \\
        --threads $task.cpus \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.tsv
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/folddisco/query"
description: "Search a prebuilt folddisco index for a discontinuous residue motif\
  \ in a query protein structure"
keywords:
- "protein structure"
- "structural motif"
- "motif search"
- "geometric hashing"
- "query"
- "pdb"
tools:
- folddisco:
    description: "Fast indexing and search of discontinuous motifs in protein structures."
    homepage: "https://github.com/steineggerlab/folddisco"
    documentation: "https://github.com/steineggerlab/folddisco"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/steineggerlab/folddisco"
    doi: "10.1038/s41587-026-03162-9"
    licence:
    - "GPL-3.0-or-later"
    identifier: "biotools:folddisco"
    args_id: "$args"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - pdb:
      type: "file"
      description: "Query protein structure file the motif residues are read from."
      pattern: "*.{pdb,cif,mmcif}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1476"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1477"
  - query:
      type: "string"
      description: "Comma-separated chain+residue motif specifiers to search for,\
        \ e.g. 'A13,A95,A167'. Individual specifiers may include an amino-acid substitution\
        \ after a colon (e.g. 'A13:S') or a residue range with a dash (e.g. 'A13-20')."
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - index:
      type: "directory"
      description: "Folddisco geometric-hashing index directory produced by the folddisco/index\
        \ module."
      pattern: "*"
      ontologies: []
  - structures:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. The same protein structure files (PDB or mmCIF) originally\
        \ passed to folddisco/index to build the index. A folddisco index is not self-contained\
        \ — it records the paths of the structures it indexed, and folddisco query\
        \ re-reads those files to compute RMSD and matching residues. Omit (pass `[]`)\
        \ only when `--skip-match` is set in `ext.args`, which skips the PDB re-read\
        \ and emits no RMSD or matching residues; otherwise omitting it fails with\
        \ `Failed to read PDB file`."
      pattern: "*.{pdb,cif,mmcif}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1476"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1477"
output:
  results:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.tsv:
        type: "file"
        description: "TSV of matching structures/motifs found in the index. Columns\
          \ are configurable via `--format-output` in ext.args; the default columns\
          \ include tid, node_count, idf, rmsd, matching_residues and query_residues."
        pattern: "*.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_folddisco:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - folddisco:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - folddisco version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - folddisco:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - folddisco version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@vagkaratzas"
maintainers:
- "@vagkaratzas"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
